_note: Phase 5. Treatment §4: subject choice does not change a system, it changes which tells are common, what the events say, and one number on the meters. This file is the manifest; each id below is fetched by src/loader.js from data/subjects/<id>.json. Adding a subject is a line here and a file there, and no JavaScript at all. A period row in data/periods.json names one with a "subject" key; a row that names none gets `default`. If adding a subject ever needs a code change, the seam has moved.
